documents.name: Medical Corps CDB SOP
documents.text: Medical Corps Career Development Board Standard Operating Procedures. The CDB is designed to provide career guidance and mentorship to Medical Corps officers. Officers should prepare by reviewing their ODC, OSR, and PSR. Key discussion topics include: promotion timeline, board certification status, operational experience, leadership positions, education goals, and AQD progression.

documents.name: Career Progression Guide
documents.text: Navy Medical Corps Career Progression Overview. O1-O3: Focus on clinical excellence, board certification, and initial operational experience. Consider FMF or other warfare qualifications. O4: Department head opportunities, begin JPME, pursue 67A/67B AQDs. O5: XO/CO billets, joint duty, senior leadership courses like SLLC. O6: Command positions, strategic assignments.

documents.name: FY27 NAVMED Course Catalog
documents.text: FY27 Navy Medicine Leadership Course Catalog, Medical Corps Edition (released 6 October 2026). DIVOLC: 5 days, service school per MILPERSMAN 1301-906, sites Bethesda/Portsmouth/San Diego. BROC: four-unit self-paced course on Navy E-Learning; fulfills 6 of 28 JMESP competencies; prerequisite for AROC. AROC: O4-O6; no FY27 schedule published as of catalog release - check the NMLPDC ACR site. ILC: CIN H-7C-0104, 4-5 days, required for officers with 7-12 years commissioned service; register at least 5 weeks prior. SLC: CIN H-7C-0107, 5 days, O5+; Dam Neck VA (CDP 19UV) and San Diego CA (CDP 19UU). IESC: JMESI virtual, 4 iterations FY27, contributes to the 67A AQD. HMC: JMESI virtual for first-time clinical supervisors, 3 iterations FY27. JPME I: NWC Fleet Seminar Program (apply Apr 1 - May 31), NWC Naval Command and Staff Online, NWC resident, ACSC DL, Marine Corps CSC. Awards AQD JS7. SWMDOIC: CIN B-6A-2301 / CDP 630B, 12 days San Diego, offered Oct, May, Jul. NMQSLA: 12 Jan - 25 Feb 2027; awards AQD 68R; required for milestone and command billets. MedXellence: 40 CE hours, FY27 dates tentative. IAIFHL: 148th Apr 2027 and 149th Sep 2027, Washington DC, 11 Navy Medicine quotas across all Corps. MHS Capstone: replacement TBD - no FY27 dates or detail section published. 67A requires a master s degree or higher, O-4 (SEL) and above, a 2-year department/division head tour, IESC or equivalent, and operational experience. 67B requires a warfare designator, JPME I, and 7 core plus 7 additional courses. 67G requires all 67A requirements plus 1 year of managed care experience. POC: CDR Marshall Hoffman, Medical Corps Career Planner, marshall.m.hoffman.mil@health.mil
